title: Barks & Brews Halloween: Rescue Puppy Yoga at Midwest Coast Brewing
description: Join Moyo Village and Paradise Rescue for a morning of (rescue) puppy yoga, costumes, and brews at Midwest Coast Brewing!
long_description:
Join Moyo Village and Paradise Rescue for a morning of (rescue) puppy yoga, costumes, and brews at Midwest Coast Brewing!

About this Event

Event DetailsDate: Sunday, November 1stTime: 10:00 AM CST (Doors open at 9:30 AM)Location: Midwest Coast Brewing Company, Chicago, IL

Event DescriptionWelcome to Barks & Brews Halloween: Rescue Puppy Yoga at Midwest Coast Brewing!
Join us for a 45-minute all-levels yoga session surrounded by adorable rescue puppies (yes, they'll be in costume) at Midwest Coast Brewing! All participants will receive a FREE drink from the brewery after class (must be 21+)
After class, you'll have plenty of time to meet the pups and take pictures, and talk to our teams to learn how to help support our rescue efforts while you sip on your brews. Who knows, you might just meet your new furry best friend!
👻COSTUMES ENCOURAGED! 👻
Interested in sponsoring this event? Sponsors may provide samples, coupons, or other goodies for our swag bags! Email ZW1pbHkgfCBtb3lvdmlsbGFnZSAhIGNvbQ== for more info.

About the OrganizationsAbout Moyo Village: Moyo Village is a nonprofit animal rescue partnership that supports local animal rescues in Puerto Rico. You can join Moyo Village on a Volunteer Trip to Puerto Rico to help with their ongoing rescue efforts!
About Paradise Rescue: Our mission revolves around the rescue and relocation of stray dogs, known as Satos, predominantly from the eastern regions of Puerto Rico, with a particular focus on areas like Rio Grande, Luquillo, and Fajardo. Through a collaborative partnership with Luquillo Safe Haven for Animals, our shelter accommodates these dogs, and we continuously strive to expand our network of foster homes both within Puerto Rico and across various U.S. states. Our objective is to ensure these animals remain out of the shelter environment. Interested in becoming a foster in Chicago? Apply to be a foster today!
All proceeds will be split between Moyo Village and Paradise Rescue to support their animal rescue
